objective: Extractors flatten a line-wrap hyphen into a space, so after normalize.ts stopped rejoining a hard hyphen before a space (PR #748, campaign fcp_ef7bb04a), a word hyphenated across a line ('recog-' / 'nition') reaches normalizeBlockText as 'recog- nition' and stays split in normalized_text, which retrieval and audits read (CLAUDE.md section 9). Every place that joins the lines of one block with a space must instead join a line that ends in a letter followed by '-' to the next line with a newline ('\n'), so normalizeBlockText rejoins it; every other line join stays a space. The places: server/services/documents/pdf.ts buildBlocks (current.lines ... .join(' ')), server/services/documents/ocr.ts (the paragraph's rows joined with ' ', where a row is the last word of its line), server/services/documents/extraction.ts ocrBlocksFor (paragraph.replace(/\s+/g, ' ') flattens the newline away), and server/services/documents/text.ts (paragraph.join(' ') at lines 33 and 69). This builds on PR #748: normalize.ts is not changed. Add tests/extractorLineWrapHyphen.test.ts.
expectedOutcome: A word hyphenated across a line break in a PDF, OCR or plain-text source is rejoined in normalized_text ('recognition'); a suspended hyphen within a line ('pre- and post-closing') is still left unchanged.
nonGoals: Changing normalize.ts or any other normalisation rule
Changing how lines are ordered or grouped into blocks

acceptanceConditions.statement: pdf.ts layoutPage on two lines of one paragraph, 'the recog-' above 'nition rule', yields a block whose text keeps the hyphen followed by a newline, and normalizeBlockText of that block text is 'the recognition rule'.

A plain-text paragraph 'the recog-\nnition rule' and an OCR paragraph whose first line ends 'recog-' each produce a block that normalizeBlockText turns into 'recognition'; a line 'pre- and post-closing' within one line is unchanged in every extractor.
tests/documents.test.ts, tests/normalizeSuspendedHyphen.test.ts and every existing extraction test pass, and the repository typechecks.
acceptanceConditions.verification: npx vitest run tests/documents.test.ts tests/normalizeSuspendedHyphen.test.ts && npm run typecheck

verificationCommands: npx vitest run tests/extractorLineWrapHyphen.test.ts tests/normalizeSuspendedHyphen.test.ts tests/documents.test.ts
rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
